title: Sorry for the downtime: 3 free days for every server
changes: RolePlayManager was offline from October 21 to October 23 because the server it runs on was switched off. Sorry for the trouble it caused
To make up for it, every server gets 3 days of Premium free, unless it already has Premium
Every server also gets 3 days of RPM CyberCom free: a bot in every voice channel for traffic stops, 10-80s and voice moderation. Set it up with /config cybercom
Both switch off on their own after 3 days. Nothing is charged, nothing you set up is deleted, and your own free trials are still there for later
